definitions.short: a constellation , i.e. Zodiacal sign (perhaps as affecting the weather)
definitions.full: H4208. mazzaloth מַזָּלוֺת noun [feminine] plural constellations , perhaps signs of the zodiac (probably loan-word from Assyrian manzaltu , mazaltu , station , abode (of gods) Dl HWB 457; Prol. 142 Jen Kosmologie 348 ; compare Late Hebrew מַזָּלוֺת , id. ; מַזָּל Aramaic מַזָּלָא , star of fortune or fate Phoenician נעם זל [ מ ] CIS 95, 8 (Vog; bilingual inscription; Greek ἀγαθῇ τύχῃ ); Syriac zodiac PS 109 ; mansiones lunae , Lexicons, PS 2332 ; Arabic (loan-word according to Hoffm ZAW iii. 1883, 110 . Suidas μαζουρωθ = ζωδία ); — only ׳לַמַּזּ 2Kin 23:5 as object of worship (+ יָרֵחַ שֶׁמֶשׁ, בֵּעַל, , and הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם כָּלצְֿבָא ) ᵐ5 τοῖς μαζουρωθ ; probably= מַזַּרוֺת Job 38:32 . מַזְלֵג , [ מִזְלָגָה ] see זלג . מְזִמָּה see זמם .. מִזְמוֺר see I. זמר . מַזְמֵרָה מְזַמֶּרֶת, see II. זמר . מִזְעָר see זער . I. מזר (? √ of following so Thes 781 compare Ba NB §164 c ; otherwise Gei Urschrift 52: Late Hebrew מָזַר and Aramaic be bad (of eggs), Arabic be foul, corrupt ).
